stories.title: Luka Dončić Scores 42 — Lakers Cruise Past Heat 138-117

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
42 points. 13 assists. 7 rebounds.

Luka Dončić now has FIVE straight games with 37+ points.

Lakers 138, Heat 117. He's averaging 38.8 PPG. Unstoppable.

#Lakers #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Giannis scored 30 last night and still called Luka "one of the best scorers to play this game."

Five straight 37+ point games. Lakers win 138-117.

That's the Dončić era. #Lakers #NBA

stories.title: Knicks 103, Nets 90 — New York Extends Rivalry Win Streak to 15

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
The Knicks trailed. Then they outscored the Nets 25-5 in the fourth quarter.

103-90 final. That's 15 straight wins over Brooklyn.

New York owns this rivalry. #Knicks #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
15 consecutive wins over the Nets.

Nearly 4 years since Brooklyn beat New York.

Landry Shamet had 22 for the Nets. Still not enough.

The streak lives. 103-90. #Knicks #NBA
